scene partybeforethe1
Back in a room where things make more sense, things weren’t making much sense.
I suppose you could say that about most of these little get-togethers, though.
Or at least parts of them. For the highlights of a tragic life would not be highlights at all if you knew they were coming.
It’s the suspense that makes it all worth it. It’s not knowing that motivates you to find out. It’s the ups and downs and turnarounds that turns paths to roads and roads to towns.
Far from here, there’s another party. One we weren’t invited to. Probably in some rich girl’s mansion and probably full of scantily clad teens fawning over someone they shouldn’t.
And far away from that one is another. Then another. Then another.
And the only thing that makes where we are now more important than those is the fact that we can guess what will happen next.
It’s not the fact that this world is weird. It’s not the fact that sometimes it might feel a little supernatural when that could just be the norm in this setting.
It’s just where and when we happen to be. But what will happen to the faces and names we’ve come to know when we finally are invited somewhere else? Somewhere better?
Or somewhere that might seem better, but...what if there’s another wall that’s even harder to scale and we just haven’t seen it yet?
What if that’s why things always come to an end on that rooftop? What if God just doesn’t want us to catch wind of a new life because we might let it carry us off to his front lawn?
Anyway, I guess what I’m trying to say here is that I want to say you should learn to look past the confusion and try to find complacency in this moment.
But I only want to say that in the first place because that’s what the outline says I’m supposed to say.
In all actuality, I don’t really want you to do anything.
I don’t want you to stand out or feel or think or even remember that there’s some sentience buried somewhere deep inside of you, because then you might leave.
You might realize this party sucks and head off to another one. In another rich girl’s mansion. With some other misguided teens. And you might enjoy it more, sure.
But you also might wind up like these two — misplaced, awkward, and unsure of who to speak to or where to look when that used to be so easy.
When the walls close in on this garden of ours, we all become wallflowers.
But there is no inherent harm in that if it’s what makes you breathe easier.
Some people just want to suffocate, I think.
And...
I think I’m one of them.
Even here, I can’t find peace.
: Sooo...
This was all for nothing.
: How’s, like...maid life going and stuff?
Those ups and downs and turnarounds I praised just moments ago have entangled to the point where I can no longer find my footing in a world that I built.
: It’s fine. How’s...promiscuous life?
Oh.
: Fine, I guess.
As I look down at my hands and their multicolored glow, I realize something. Or I make something up. Or I trick myself into thinking that-
I didn’t build this world at all.
It has always been here.
: I take exception to my life being called “promiscuous,” though. I’m really not like that.
And it will remain so long as the rules are followed.
scene partybeforethe2
: Yeah, I know. I just...wasn’t really sure how else to respond since you caught me off guard.
Please-
Don’t leave me alone again.
: You doing okay? It’s weird seeing you not, like...running around and talking to everybody at these things.
: The...same could be said for you, couldn’t it? Why aren’t you hanging out with Noriko? Or Miku or...your other friends?
scene partybeforethe3
: Thanks for pretending I have other friends. I now forgive you for calling me “promiscuous.”
: I don’t always have to be with them, though. In fact, I’m normally pretty alone. I’m used to it. Just...not normally in a party setting.
: But hey, a lot’s been changing lately. So maybe I’ll wind up just as jaded and antisocial as Io after a few more of these things.
: I wasn’t pretending you have other friends, Kirin. You do. You just might not be as close to them as you are with the others.
scene partybeforethe4
: That’s not really a problem, though. Like...Io is my only close friend. So in that department, you’re kind of beating me.
: Yeah, maybe. But do you ever really feel alone, Uta?
scene partybeforethe5
: Huh?
: Is that smile you keep plastered to your face all day every day a reflection of how you actually feel? Or do you just keep it there because it makes pretending to be happy easier?
scene partybeforethe6
: It’s no problem if you do. That’s not me, like...trying to call you out or anything. It’s just that I kind of do the same thing.
: Pretending to be something you’re not can be exhausting, though. Which is why girls like us need to decompress by awkwardly retreating to the sidelines at parties sometimes.
: I don’t think there’s any shame in that, though. So, from one poser to another — good luck.
: We clearly need it.
scene partybeforethe7
: You look really pretty today, Kirin.
scene partybeforethe8
: Thanks.
: You too, Uta.
scene partybeforethe9
: Secret meeting — start! Let the planning of our next slumber party commence!
: Is it really a secret if you shout it at the top of your lungs in a room full of our classmates?
: I kind of have to since Noriko invited Good Kid again. The sound system in here is too powerful and this song is filling me with a deep melancholy.
: Yeah, I have no idea how Kirin and Uta are having a conversation like, right in front of them. They’re going to go deaf.
scene partybeforethe10
: WHAT?! I CAN’T HEAR YOU GUYS!
: Oh no. The melancholy has already consumed Noriko.
: WHAT KIND OF DOG WAS IT?!
scene partybeforethe11
: Two questions.
: Two answers.
: The fuck happened to your gloves? They’ve got more holes in ‘em than my socks.
: Various types of acids. Don’t worry about it. What’s your second question?
: I only have more now.
: Okay, but what was the original second question? We don’t have all day, Yumi! It’s only a matter of time until our secret meeting is discovered!
: THEY FOUND WHAT IN FIJI?!
: We’re really doin’ this shit again? After the last time accomplished literally nothing?
scene partybeforethe12
: It didn’t accomplish nothing! We managed to enlist you, didn’t we?! It just...didn’t accomplish what we thought it would accomplish! But that’s what the second one is for!
: You sure you don’t just...really fuckin’ like slumber parties?
scene partybeforethe13
: Me? Pfft. Of course not! I’m doing this to save the world and bring back my friend. As if I’d use that as an excuse to stay up late and eat snacks with my other friends.
scene partybeforethe14
: But yeah! We’re doing it again. Just this time, I’m going to try and get even more girls involved. So everyone is getting an invite and we’re going balls to the wall!
: Aight. But only one of us has balls and I’m bailing the second anyone starts talkin’ about them.
scene partybeforethe15
: Hi. Testicle-bearer here. Why didn’t we just do it like this to begin with?
: Because Ayane is just making all of this up as she goes. And probably cares more about the slumber parties than the actual apocalypse like Yumi suggested.
: I care about both! There’s no rule against that!
scene partybeforethe16
: Than why not seize this opportunity to make an announcement in front of everyone?
: While those Canadians are up there playin’ music and shit? Ain’t that kinda rude?
: Yeah. I can’t just interrupt Good Kid, Makoto. They’re stuck here until they’re allowed to leave the country again, so the least we can do is show them what omotenashi is all about.
: Should I...go get Molly for another weebnote?...
: Not right now! Besides, Maya and Ami still aren’t here.
: Isn’t that a good thing? I thought we were trying to keep this away from them?
scene partybeforethe17
: Ami, yes. Maya is more of a mixed bag. But just inviting them to the mega slumber party isn’t giving anything away. Like, wouldn’t it be more suspicious if they weren’t invited?
: Probably not for Ami. Pretty much everyone hates her now, don’t they?
: Everybody hates me too. This shit sounds fuckin’ horrible, I ain’t gonna lie.
: You guys just don’t get it!
scene partybeforethe18
: Are you hearing any of this, Sana? Because my ears aren’t great to begin with and it doesn’t help that I think I just heard Yumi say she wants to fuck Ami.
: Sana? You’re not deaf too, aren’t you?
: You’ve been...holding onto his arm for...a while now...
scene partybeforethe19
: Do you...want a turn?
: Can I...actually have one?
scene partybeforethe20
: Of course! Just give me another few minutes to finish recharging my battery and we can swap places. But you can hold mine in the meantime if you want!
: Do I need to start charging rent for my arm?
scene partybeforethe21
: YOU’RE BUYING A FARM?!
: How can you hear me and not him?...
scene partybeforethe22
: So! Where are we going to do it this time?! Sensei’s house? There’s still the matter of that one Dorm Wars prize no one ever redeemed, isn’t there?
: Sure, if you all want to sleep in the street outside. No one really drives down it, so you’ll probably be safe.
: Are you certain you don’t want to hold another meeting with Yumi this time now that she’s able to...you know...be involved with this to a certain extent?
: Being able to and wanting to are two totally different things. This shit goes way over my head. Just let me fuckin’ pretend it ain’t real or whatever.
: What...are you guys even talking about? I’m not really sure I’m...following.
: That’s because the world doesn’t want you to follow, Sana! Which is why you will now repeat after yourself when I tell you we’re caught in-
: What...are you guys even talking about? I’m not really sure I’m...following.
scene partybeforethe23
: Sana? Why are you repeating yourself? Didn’t you just say that?
: Wait a second! Does this mean Noriko-
: She isn’t aware. She just can’t hear us.
: God, that repetition shit never stops being weird as hell. Can’t believe I live in a fuckin’ anime now.
scene partybeforethe24
: OKAY! BUT THEN YOU’LL HAVE TO WASH MINE AS WELL!
: What...did she even think she heard that time?
: Probably best if we never find out...
So there they were! Just an hour or two into the party and already planning out what comes next.
Of course, not all of them were on the same wavelength. Especially when there are INFINITE wavelengths carrying INFINITE messages to INFINITE people.
But that’s PART OF THE CHARM. It’s the REASON WE’RE HERE. We exist to DELIVER THOSE MESSAGES ourselves because radios are weak now! Its consciousness that moves!
The earth doesn’t spin! The earth is flat! You’ve already seen where the sidewalk ends! You’ve already fallen through the map! You know this to be true!
Stop thinking you are where you aren’t! Stretch out your arms and embrace the way it feels to don the fresh skin of tainted youth, for it makes tainting youth all the more palatable!
scene partybeforethe25
What if there was no one at the party?
What if everyone did leave? And I was here, talking to myself, manipulating the reflections in the floor so you would never see mine?
What IF I say to live is SIN?! To panic as the walls close in?! Where DOES that ancient guardian relieve itself if not WITHIN?
scene partybeforethe26
The sculptures leave too.
scene partybeforethe27
As do the chains.
scene black
And then there is nothing.
But there will not be “nothing” for long.
Soon, a creator will come and do what a creator does.
Give you a reason to stop.
To stay.
To think, sometimes, when the mood is right.
Or to fail.
It’s only human to make mistakes.
But what if humans are mistakes?

: KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!
